sentences.en: It's great to see so many members of the Twinning Association here tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚见到这么多双城协会的成员，真是太好了。

sentences.en: Since the twinning link between our two towns, Stanthorpe here in England and Malatte in France, was established, the relationship between the towns has gone from strength to strength.
sentences.zh: 自从我们英国斯坦索普镇和法国马勒特镇建立双城结对关系以来，两镇之间的关系日益紧密、不断加强。

sentences.en: Last month, 25 members of the association from Stanthorpe spent a weekend in Malatte.
sentences.zh: 上个月，来自斯坦索普的25名协会成员在马勒特度过了一个周末。

sentences.en: Our hosts had arranged a great programme.
sentences.zh: 我们的东道主安排了一个非常精彩的活动日程。

sentences.en: We learned how cheese is produced in the region and had the chance to taste the products.
sentences.zh: 我们了解了当地奶酪的制作过程，并有机会品尝这些产品。

sentences.en: The theme park trip had to be cancelled, but we all had a great time on the final boat trip down the river - that was the real highlight.
sentences.zh: 原计划的主题公园之旅不得不取消，但最后沿河而下的乘船之旅令大家玩得非常尽兴——那才是真正的亮点。

sentences.en: This is a special year for the Association because it's 25 years since we were founded.
sentences.zh: 今年对协会而言意义非凡，因为我们成立至今已有25年了。

sentences.en: In Malatte, they're planning to mark this by building a footbridge in the municipal park.
sentences.zh: 在马勒特，他们计划通过在市政公园内修建一座人行桥来纪念这一里程碑。

sentences.en: We've been discussing what to do here and we've decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum gardens.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论本地该做些什么，最终决定在博物馆花园里种植一棵杨树。

sentences.en: We considered buying a garden seat to put there, but the authorities weren't happy with that idea.
sentences.zh: 我们曾考虑购买一张花园长椅放在那里，但主管部门对这个想法并不认可。

sentences.en: In terms of fundraising to support our activities, we've done very well.
sentences.zh: 在为支持协会活动而开展的筹款方面，我们成绩斐然。

sentences.en: Our pancake evening was well attended and made record profits.
sentences.zh: 我们的煎饼晚会参与人数众多，创下了盈利新高。

sentences.en: And everyone enjoyed the demonstration of French cookery, which was nearly as successful.
sentences.zh: 而法国烹饪技艺演示也广受欢迎，虽略逊于煎饼晚会，但也取得了近乎同样成功的效果。

sentences.en: Numbers for our film show were limited because of the venue so we're looking for somewhere bigger next year.
sentences.zh: 由于场地限制，我们的电影放映活动名额有限，因此明年我们正寻找更大的场地。

sentences.en: We're looking forward to welcoming our French visitors here next week, and know that many of you here will be hosting individuals or families.
sentences.zh: 我们热切期待下周欢迎法国友人来访，相信在座各位中许多人将接待个人访客或家庭。

sentences.en: The coach from France will arrive at 5 pm on Friday.
sentences.zh: 来自法国的大巴将于周五下午5点抵达。

sentences.en: Don't try to do 100 much that first evening as they'll be tired, so have dinner in the house or garden rather than eating out.
sentences.zh: 请勿在他们抵达当晚安排过多活动，因为他们会很疲惫，建议在家或花园里共进晚餐，而非外出就餐。

sentences.en: The weather looks as if it'll be OK so you might like tO plan a barbecue.
sentences.zh: 天气预报显示天气状况良好，因此您或许可以计划举办一场烧烤。

sentences.en: Then the next morning's market day in town, and that's always a good place to stroll round.
sentences.zh: 次日上午是镇上的集市日，那里向来是悠闲漫步的好去处。

sentences.en: On Saturday evening, we'll all meet up at the football club, where once again we'll have Toby Sharp and his band performing English and Scottish country songs.
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，我们所有人将在足球俱乐部集合，届时托比·夏普及其乐队将再次登台，献上英苏乡村歌曲表演。

sentences.en: Toby will already be well known to many of you as last year he organised our special quiz night and presented the prizes.
sentences.zh: 托比对在座许多朋友而言已不陌生，因为去年他组织了我们的特别问答之夜并颁发了奖品。

sentences.en: Now on Sunday, we'll be taking our visitors to Farley House.
sentences.zh: 周日，我们将带访客前往法利庄园。

sentences.en: You may not all be familiar with it, so here's a map to help you.
sentences.zh: 您可能并非所有人都熟悉这个地方，因此这里附上一份地图以供参考。

sentences.en: You can see the car park at the bottom of the map.
sentences.zh: 您可在地图底部看到停车场位置。

sentences.en: There's an excellent farm shop in the grounds where our visitors can buy local produce - it's in the old stables, which is the first building you come to.
sentences.zh: 庄园内设有一家极佳的农场商店，访客可在此购买本地农产品——商店位于旧马厩内，即您抵达后首先见到的建筑。

sentences.en: They're built round a courtyard, and the shop's in the far corner on the left.
sentences.zh: 马厩围绕庭院而建，商店位于左后方角落。

sentences.en: There's also a small café on the right as you go in.
sentences.zh: 您一进门右侧还有一家小型咖啡馆。

sentences.en: I know that one or two of our visitors may not be all that mobile.
sentences.zh: 我知道部分访客行动可能不太便利。

sentences.en: The main entrance to the house has a lot of steps so you might want to use the disabled entry.
sentences.zh: 庄园主入口台阶较多，因此您或许希望使用无障碍通道入口。

sentences.en: This is on the far side of the house from the car park.
sentences.zh: 该无障碍入口位于房屋远离停车场的一侧。

sentences.en: Children will probably be most interested in the adventure playground.
sentences.zh: 孩子们可能对冒险游乐场最感兴趣。

sentences.en: That's at the northern end of the larger lake, in a bend on the path that leads to the lake.
sentences.zh: 游乐场位于较大湖泊的北端，在通往湖泊的小径拐弯处。

sentences.en: There's lots for children to do there.
sentences.zh: 那里为孩子们提供了大量活动项目。

sentences.en: There are a number of lovely gardens near the house.
sentences.zh: 庄园附近还有数座优美的花园。

sentences.en: The kitchen gardens are rectangular and surrounded by a wall.
sentences.zh: 厨房花园呈矩形，四周有围墙环绕。

sentences.en: They're to the north-east of the house, quite near the smaller lake.
sentences.zh: 它们位于庄园东北方向，离较小的湖泊相当近。

sentences.en: They're still in use and have great collection of fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 这些花园仍在使用中，栽种着丰富多样的水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: The Temple of the Four Winds is a bit more of a walk but it's worth it.
sentences.zh: 四风神庙稍远一些，需步行一段距离，但绝对值得一游。

sentences.en: Take the path from the car park and go past the western sides of the stables and the house.
sentences.zh: 请从停车场出发，沿着小径经过马厩和庄园的西侧。

sentences.en: Then when the path forks, take the right-hand path.
sentences.zh: 随后当小径分岔时，请选择右侧小径。

sentences.en: Go up there with the woods on your left and the temple is right at the end.
sentences.zh: 沿着那条路往前走，树林在你的左边，寺庙就在尽头。

sentences.en: There are great views over the whole area.
sentences.zh: 从那里可以俯瞰整个区域，景色非常棒。

sentences.en: OK, so that's .
sentences.zh: 好的，就这样。
